definitions.explanation: Describes something or someone so exceptional that it occurs only rarely across generations. Used as a modifier before nouns to express that something is the most remarkable of its kind.

examples.japanese: {希代|きだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天才|てんさい}→天才：09934_tensai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれた→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: He was called a once-in-a-generation genius.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{希代|きだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悪女|あくじょ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: She went down in history as an extraordinary villainess.

examples.japanese: {希代|きだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{百年|ひゃくねん}→百年：28401_hyakunen⟧⟦{経|た}った→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{読|よ}み{継|つ}がれて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This novel, said to be an extraordinary masterpiece, is still read even a hundred years later.

notes:
Composed of {希|き} (rare, uncommon) + ⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧ (generation, era). Literally means 'rare across generations,' implying something so exceptional it appears only once in many lifetimes. Also written as {稀代|きだい} (with a different kanji for 'rare'). Used almost exclusively as a prenominal modifier ({希代|きだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {希代|きだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天才|てんさい}→天才：09934_tensai⟧: once-in-a-generation genius
- {希代|きだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧: extraordinary masterpiece
- {希代|きだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{悪党|あくとう}→悪党：12674_akutou⟧: unprecedented villain
- {希代|きだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{英雄|えいゆう}→英雄：14117_eiyuu⟧: extraordinary hero

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{稀有|けう}→稀有：13781_keu⟧: extremely rare — emphasizes rarity; often used for unusual situations
- ⟦{空前|くうぜん}→空前：22320_kuuzen⟧: unprecedented — literally 'never before seen'
- {不世出|ふせいしゅつ}: appearing once in a generation — similar in meaning; more literary
